accessNotes: TradeDay's current homepage exposes all nine TradeDay 2.0 pricing cards in server-rendered HTML. Prices captured here are the live 55%-off prices displayed on 2026-07-28 with code TDNEW, not the crossed-out list prices. The homepage and /how-it-works disagree on Fast Pass minimum evaluation days: the current product cards say 'Min trading days 3', while /how-it-works says 'No minimum on Fast Pass.' The specific live product cards were used and the conflict is preserved in notes. Older /our-pricing search results describe a previous product set and were not used. TradeDay states that subscriptions are non-refundable and rebill until passed or cancelled. No geo-block was encountered.

notes: PROMOTIONAL MONTHLY PRICE: the captured prices ($59 / $108 / $162) are the live 55%-off prices displayed with code TDNEW on 2026-07-28. Crossed-out list prices are $131 / $240 / $360. Confirm the live checkout price before purchase because a promotional subscription price can change.

MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION, not a one-off fee. TradeDay's terms say the evaluation fee is paid for access to the challenge and a new subscription payment produces an automatic reset. The homepage labels every captured fee 'per month'.
NO ACTIVATION FEE: each current product card says 'No activation fee'.
PROFIT TARGETS are stated in dollars: $3,000 on $50K, $6,000 on $100K and $9,000 on $150K. Each equals 6% of the headline account size.

TRAILING MAX DRAWDOWN is stated in dollars and is not uniform as a percentage: $2,000 on $50K (4%), $3,000 on $100K (3%) and $4,500 on $150K (3%). maxLossPct is therefore null instead of forcing one percentage across all tiers.

INTRADAY DRAWDOWN: the homepage says the maximum drawdown is calculated intraday. The previous pricing explainer defined Intraday TMD as tracking unrealized profits in real time and freezing at the starting balance.
FIVE-DAY PASS: the current Quick Pay cards say 'Min trading days 5'; /how-it-works repeats '5 days on Quick Pay'.
30% CONSISTENCY: every Quick Pay evaluation card states 'Consistency 30%'. No funded-stage consistency rule is listed: the Funded Sim block says 'Consistency: None'.

FIRST PAYOUT DAY: the Funded Sim block says 'Min Days to Payout: 1', 'Payout Buffer: None', 'Min Payout Request: $250' and 'Milestones: None'. The FAQ says a payout can be requested from any positive balance on day one and most requests are processed within 24 hours.

TIERED PROFIT SPLIT: Quick Pay Funded Sim pays '50/50 below $4k net profit, 80/20 above $4k net profit, 90/10 in Funded Live'. profitSplitPct is recorded as 50 because that is the trader's initial marginal split and produces the conservative first-dollar break-even calculation.

DAY TRADING ONLY: TradeDay's terms name the Permitted Times rule: 'Day-trading only and all positions must be closed at least 10 minutes prior to the end of any session.' This excludes overnight and weekend holds.
NEWS WINDOW: TradeDay's May 9, 2026 economic-release policy says traders must be flat, with no working orders, from 2 minutes before until 2 minutes after tier-1 releases.

AUTOMATION: the terms prohibit 'trading bots or Automated Trading Systems (ATS) purchased from a third party' and multiple users using the same bots or ATS. They also prohibit software, AI, ultra-high-speed or mass-data-entry systems that manipulate or create an unfair advantage. This is recorded as restricted, not a blanket EA ban.
COPY TRADING is null because TradeDay's public pages reviewed do not state a simple permitted/not-permitted rule for copying the same user's trades across personal accounts.
PERMITTED PRODUCTS are futures listed on CME, CBOT, NYMEX and COMEX. Stocks, options, forex, spot crypto and CFDs are not available.
REFUNDS: the homepage footer says all subscription fees are non-refundable except where required by law.
PASS-RATE DISCLOSURE: the homepage states that 36% of evaluation programs passed between January 2026 and June 2026 and warns that the simulation is difficult even for experienced traders.
FUNDED STAGE: TradeDay describes Funded Sim as simulated and publishes a defined route to Funded Live, where the profit split becomes 90%.

MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION with no activation fee. All subscription fees are non-refundable except where required by law.
PROFIT TARGETS are $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000, equal to 6% of $50K / $100K / $150K.
EOD TRAILING DRAWDOWN is $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500. It is null as a percentage because those caps imply 4% / 3% / 3%. The funded Fast Pass cards also say the drawdown is calculated EOD.

MINIMUM-DAYS CONFLICT: the current product cards say 'Min trading days 3', while /how-it-works says 'No minimum on Fast Pass.' The more specific live cards are recorded as 3 and the conflict is unresolved.
45% CONSISTENCY applies during the evaluation. The funded Fast Pass block also lists 45% consistency.
FIRST PAYOUT requires five days: the funded blocks state 'Min Days to Payout: 5' and five profitable days, each at least $150 on $50K, $200 on $100K or $250 on $150K.
PAYOUT LIMITS: minimum request is $250. Maximum requests are $1,500 on $50K, $1,875 on $100K and $2,250 on $150K.
PROFIT SPLIT is 80% in Funded Sim and 90% in Funded Live.
POSITION LIMITS in Funded Sim begin at 2 / 3 / 4 contracts for $50K / $100K / $150K and scale by one contract for each $2,000 of end-of-day profit.
The same day-trading-only, tier-1 news window, third-party automation restriction and futures-only rules apply.
Copy trading remains null because no simple public personal-account copying rule was verified.
